confirm.commitConsequenceFull: Committing posts a permanent inventory adjustment for each of the {n} counted variances and files this full count as the statutory Inventar (Bestandesnachweis, OR 958c). Posted movements are immutable and can only be corrected by a compensating movement.
confirm.commitConsequenceCycle: Committing posts a permanent inventory adjustment for each of the {n} counted variances. Posted movements are immutable and can only be corrected by a compensating movement.
confirm.cancelConsequence: Cancelling discards this open count session and every count entered in it. The frozen book snapshot and the recorded counts cannot be recovered.

CycleCounts.title: Cycle counts
CycleCounts.body: Stocktakes and cycle counts: a counting session freezes the book quantity, then you count, and the variances are reviewed and approved. On commit every variance is posted as its own immutable stock movement; on-hand is never overwritten directly. A blind count hides the book column until the session reaches review.
